item.title: dria v1.8.0
item.description:
• Excel agent (real tool use, not a snapshot). ⌘⌥E now runs an iterative agent on Google AI models: the AI can call read_cell, read_range, write_cell, get_selection, list_sheets on demand. It looks up specific cells, sums ranges, etc., then writes the final answer back. Genuine MCP-style tool-use loop, capped at 8 turns.
  • Falls back to the v1.7.12 one-shot path for Vertex AI / Claude / OpenAI / Ollama (those need their own tool-use wiring later).
  • Every agent run is logged to ~/Library/Logs/dria/excel-agent-<ts>.log with each tool call + result for debugging.
  • Marquee shows live turn-by-turn progress ("read_cell", "read_range", etc.).

item.title: dria v1.7.12
item.description:
• Diagnostic: every ⌘⌥E round-trip now writes a log to ~/Library/Logs/dria/excel-<timestamp>.log with the prompt, raw model response, and post-stripper output. Lets us diagnose "nothing happened" reports without guessing.
  • Better marquee message when the model returns empty — distinguishes "model returned nothing" from "stripper reduced to empty (raw: …)".

item.title: dria v1.7.11
item.description:
• Honest fix: whole-sheet context was silently broken in v1.7.9 and v1.7.10. Three AppleScript syntax bugs caused workbookContext to error out and fall back to single-cell mode, which is why the AI hallucinated cell values: it had zero sheet context. Verified end-to-end against live Excel via NSAppleScript.
  • Fixed: `cell N column M of ws` form fails to parse on Excel for Mac for reads — now uses address-based range syntax (built via an AppleScript colLetter handler).
  • Fixed: `get address sel local form false external form false` doesn't parse — simplified to `get address of sel`.
  • Fixed: literal "\\n" used as a separator in AppleScript (which doesn't honor C-style escapes); now uses `(ASCII character 10)` so the Swift parser actually finds the LFs it expects.

item.title: dria v1.7.10
item.description:
• Fix: ⌘⌥E TSV context now includes A1-style row and column headers so the AI can resolve cell references precisely (was: hallucinating values for specific cells because the grid was unlabeled).
  • Fix: prompt rewritten with explicit "look up by header" and "do not invent values" rules + structured handling for empty cells.
  • Fix: defensive preamble stripper drops "Cell X contains the value Y. ---" wrappers before writing to the cell.

item.title: dria v1.7.9
item.description:
• ⌘⌥E (Excel cell ask) now passes the entire used range of the active sheet to the AI as TSV context — like a one-shot Excel MCP. The AI can reference other cells, totals, headers, etc., not just the selected cell.
  • Truncates to 100 × 26 cells to stay under prompt-size limits; reports total vs. shown dimensions in the context block.
  • Selection address (e.g., B3) included so the AI knows where the question lives.
  • Prompt explicitly tells the model: "reply with the answer only, no preamble" — keeps the cell content clean.

item.title: dria v1.7.8
item.description:
• Excel via AppleScript: new hotkey ⌘⌥E reads the selected Excel cell, sends it to your active mode's AI, and writes the answer to the cell directly below. Falls back to clipboard if Excel automation is denied. Bypasses the Mac Excel local-sideload restriction entirely — no Office add-in needed.
  • Configurable from Settings → General → Shortcuts.
  • First use will trigger a macOS Automation permission prompt ("dria.app wants permission to control Microsoft Excel"). Grant it once; it persists.

item.title: dria v1.7.7
item.description:
• Retrieval: switched to Apple NLContextualEmbedding (macOS 14+ transformer) with NLEmbedding fallback. Cache keys now include the backend identifier so model swaps invalidate stale vectors automatically.
  • Stability: HangWatchdog raised to 60s fatal threshold and gained a beginLongOperation/endLongOperation API. Cold embedding loads, KB indexing, Vertex JWT mint, and large OCR are now wrapped so legitimate slow work no longer trips the watchdog. Hang logs include a real main-thread backtrace captured via /usr/bin/sample.
  • Crash capture: sigaltstack + sigaction(3-arg) so stack-overflow SIGSEGV can still run our handler instead of compounding the fault.
  • Bridge security: HTTP parser now RFC 9112-compliant — rejects Content-Length + Transfer-Encoding combo, duplicate CL, non-digit CL, bare CR/LF in headers, whitespace before colon. Enforces 8 KB header cap, 2 MB body cap, 10 s header timeout, 30 s body timeout. Returns 408/413/501 instead of silently closing.
  • Prompt injection: /v1/classify and /v1/extract wrap user text in <user_input nonce="..."> delimiters; output validated (classify must match one of the supplied categories; extract rejects leaked wrapper).
  • Cancellation: switching modes mid-index now cleanly cancels the in-flight embedding job instead of leaking until done.

item.title: dria v1.7.6
item.description:
• Security: LLM bridge now binds to loopback only via NWParameters.requiredInterfaceType = .loopback + acceptLocalOnly, with belt-and-braces remote-endpoint check rejecting any non-127.0.0.1/::1 connection. (Audit found acceptLocalOnly alone wasn't loopback-only on hosts with VPN/Docker bridges.)
  • Security: CORS wildcard replaced with explicit origin allowlist covering localhost dev hosts + Office taskpane origins (officeapps.live.com, office.com, outlook.office.com, outlook.office365.com, officeusercontent.com). Vary: Origin set; no token reflected in CORS-readable headers.
  • Security: bridge auth token moved to login Keychain with kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly. One-time migration from on-disk file. New "Rotate" button in Settings to invalidate cached tokens.
  • Roadmap published (ROADMAP.md) with prioritized hardening backlog from the security audit.

item.title: dria v1.7.5
item.description:
• Refactor: AppState split into focused helpers (ChatPersistence, AIProviderFactory, ChatPDFExporter); SettingsView split into one file per tab.
  • Semantic RAG: on-device NLEmbedding-based knowledge retrieval. Works with every AI provider, fully offline, no API key needed. Falls back to keyword TF-IDF when unavailable.
  • Excel integration: local bridge server on 127.0.0.1:7842 (bearer-token auth) exposes =CHATGPT, =DRIA_CLASSIFY, =DRIA_EXTRACT plus an "Ask dria" ribbon button. See excel-addin/README.md.
  • Crash & hang logging: NSException + signal handlers write to ~/Library/Logs/dria/. Main-thread watchdog logs warnings at 3 s, force-crashes at 20 s for a real diagnostic report.
  • Layout spin fix: ResponseView caps display at 4000 chars with "Show all" expander; ChatArea uses VStack (not LazyVStack) for the 20-message window; OCR output is cleaned (orphan glyphs dropped, blank-line runs collapsed, 8 KB cap).
  • Recent Issues UI in Settings → General lists + opens crash / hang logs.
